feeds.title: My Teaching Cupboard Blog
feeds.description: A blog for early childhood teachers with ideas to implement an educational play based curriculum. Learn how to deliver an age appropriate pedagogy based on Reggio Emilia, Montessori and Walker Learning approaches. Teach through investigative play and still meet curriculum benchmarks.

feeds.title: Teacher Tom
feeds.description: A blog about teaching and learning from preschoolers. Thomas Hobson is a preschool teacher & author of Teacher Tom's First Book. He is inspired by the idea of helping thousands of educators to take their financial futures into their own hands almost as much as the idea of creating thousands of high-quality preschools.

feeds.title: Play to Learn Preschool Preschool Blog
feeds.description: At Play to Learn Preschool, we believe that children learn best when they are actively engaged in creative, meaningful play! We love to share ideas for hands-on centers, swoon-worthy process art projects, creative dramatic play areas, and literacy-rich activities with other preschool teachers. Our classroom is a delightful place to learn.

feeds.title: Teach The TK Way Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tina. I have spent the last 15 years fine-tuning my own classroom environments. Over the years I have learned from my mistakes and collected data on what works, what doesn't, and how to put it all together in a complete package. And now I am offering my secrets to you!

feeds.title: The Empowered Educator Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jode & I work with children and parents and until recently was running my own family day care business here in Australia. I am an early childhood educator and Mum. Join me for lots of play based learning info,activities &resources!

feeds.title: Okinja ELC Blog
feeds.description: At Okinja Early Learning we welcome you and your child into our childcare center, which we have created to be an extension of the family home. Our vision is to provide a safe, warm, and stimulating environment where early childhood education and quality of child care are of the highest priority. Our play-based learning philosophy focuses on promoting natural elements, play theory, and Reggio-inspired practices using an Emergent style approach.

feeds.title: Clovel Blog
feeds.description: At Clovel, our philosophy is based on love. Our belief 'if you're getting the loving right, everything else will follow' means our educators strive to ensure your children feel nurtured and appreciated as they learn in a safe environment. We will always be responsive to your child's feelings and needs, to stimulate their curiosity and thinking whilst providing a warm and loving atmosphere.

feeds.title: Toondemy Blog
feeds.description: With Toondemy, we want parents around the world to be able to leverage the latest tech and the best early childhood learning techniques without compromising on high-quality content. Our team has been able to effectively combine powerful technology, interaction, and learning tools with your child's favorite characters and stories.
